## The task

> Write tests for the crawl of scenario 05 that run with no network and no model, with the language's usual test runner. First, a unit test of the book-page handler fed a saved copy of one book page, checking the item it produces, including the category passed to it. Second, a test that runs the whole crawl from the responses recorded during one earlier live run, and checks that the dataset holds the expected number of books. 1	"""Golden scenario 05: crawl two page types into a Dataset. Scenarios 07 and 10 import its crawl; it runs only as a
2	script (`python -m scenarios.s05_two_page_crawl`)."""
3	
4	import asyncio
5	import re
6	from decimal import Decimal
7	
8	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
9	
10	from goodfetch_foxhound import (
11	    AsyncCrawl,
12	    AsyncCrawlContext,
13	    AsyncFoxhound,
14	    CrawlRequestBlocked,
15	    CrawlRequestFailed,
16	    CrawlRequestSkipped,
17	    seed,
18	)
19	
20	
21	class Book(BaseModel):
22	    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
23	    price: Decimal = Field(decimal_places=2)  # pounds, exact
24	    in_stock: int = Field(ge=0)
25	    rating: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)
26	    url: str
27	    category: str = Field(min_length=1)
28	
29	
30	class CategoryPayload(BaseModel):
31	    name: str = Field(min_length=1)
32	
33	
34	class BookPayload(BaseModel):
35	    category: str = Field(min_length=1)
36	
37	
38	# The declaration does no I/O, so the module holds it and importing it runs nothing.
39	crawl = AsyncCrawl()
40	books = crawl.dataset("books", schema=Book, key=("url",))
41	home = crawl.label("home")
42	category = crawl.label("category", payload=CategoryPayload)
43	book = crawl.label("book", payload=BookPayload)
44	# Staying on books.toscrape.com is the default scope (the seed's host), and robots.txt, one request at a time with a
45	# second between starts and backing off on 429 are the default Politeness.
46	seeds = [seed("https://books.toscrape.com/", home)]
47	
48	RATINGS = ("One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five")
49	
50	
51	@crawl.handle(home)
52	async def on_home(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[None]) -> None:
53	    # The nested list leaves out the top-level "Books"; each link's own text is its Payload.
54	    links = ctx.page.locator(".side_categories ul ul a")
55	    await ctx.enqueue_links(
56	        links, category, lambda link: CategoryPayload(name=link.text.strip())
57	    )
58	
59	
60	@crawl.handle(category)
61	async def on_category(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[CategoryPayload]) -> None:
62	    name = ctx.request.payload.name
63	    await ctx.enqueue_links(
64	        ctx.page.locator("article.product_pod h3 a"), book, BookPayload(category=name)
65	    )
66	    await ctx.enqueue_links(
67	        ctx.page.locator("li.next a"), ctx.request.label, ctx.request.payload
68	    )
69	
70	
71	@crawl.handle(book)
72	async def on_book(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[BookPayload]) -> None:
73	    main = ctx.page.locator(".product_main")
74	    text = await main.text_content()
75	    price = re.search(r"£(\d+\.\d{2})", text)
76	    stock = re.search(r"\((\d+) available\)", text)
77	    stars = await main.locator(".star-rating").get_attribute("class") or ""
78	    rating = next((n for n, word in enumerate(RATINGS, 1) if word in stars), None)
79	    if price is None or stock is None or rating is None:
80	        ctx.skip(f"no price, stock or rating on the page (stars {stars!r})")
81	    await ctx.push(
82	        books,
83	        Book(
84	            title=await main.locator("h1").text_content(),
85	            price=Decimal(price[1]),
86	            in_stock=int(stock[1]),
87	            rating=rating,
88	            url=ctx.page.url,  # the final URL, after redirects
89	            category=ctx.request.payload.category,
90	        ),
91	    )
92	
93	
94	async def main() -> None:
95	    async with (
96	        AsyncFoxhound.connect() as foxhound,
97	        await foxhound.start_crawl(crawl, seeds=seeds) as run,
98	    ):
99	        report = await run.finish()
100	        exported = await run.export(books, format="json")
101	        await exported.save_as("books.json")
102	        print(f"exported {exported.records} books to books.json")
103	
104	        async for outcome in run.outcomes(kinds=["failed", "skipped", "blocked"]):
105	            match outcome:
106	                case CrawlRequestFailed(request=request, error=error):
107	                    print(f"failed {request.url}: {error.code}: {error}")
108	                case CrawlRequestSkipped(
109	                    request=request, reason=reason, message=message
110	                ):
111	                    print(f"skipped {request.url}: {reason} {message or ''}")
112	                case CrawlRequestBlocked(request=request, block_cause=cause):
113	                    print(f"blocked {request.url}: {cause}")
114	                case _:
115	                    pass
116	        totals = report.requests
117	        print(
118	            f"{totals.succeeded} succeeded, {totals.failed} failed, {totals.skipped} skipped, {totals.blocked} blocked"
119	        )
120	        if report.nothing_done is not None:
121	            print(f"nothing done: {report.nothing_done.reason}")
122	
123	
124	if __name__ == "__main__":
125	    asyncio.run(main())

1	"""Golden scenario 08: extract with AI inside a crawl, learning once per page type.
2	
3	The declaration needs no connection, so scenario 10's offline tests import it; `main` runs only as a script.
4	"""
5	
6	import asyncio
7	from datetime import timedelta
8	from decimal import Decimal
9	from typing import Literal
10	
11	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
12	
13	from goodfetch_foxhound import (
14	    AsyncCrawl,
15	    AsyncCrawlContext,
16	    AsyncFoxhound,
17	    CrawlRequestFailed,
18	    CrawlRequestSkipped,
19	    Money,
20	    seed,
21	)
22	
23	
24	class Book(BaseModel):
25	    """What the model extracts from a book's page."""
26	
27	    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
28	    price: Decimal = Field(decimal_places=2)  # pounds, exact
29	    in_stock: int = Field(ge=0)
30	    rating: Literal[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
31	
32	
33	class BookRecord(Book):
34	    url: str
35	
36	
37	PLAN = "books.plan.json"
38	"""The Plan file: one entry for the book's extraction, compiled once per page layout (ADR 0091)."""
39	
40	crawl = AsyncCrawl()
41	books = crawl.dataset("books", schema=BookRecord, key=("url",))
42	home = crawl.label("home")
43	category = crawl.label("category")
44	# A first compile runs inside its handler, so it gets more than `timeout.handler`'s 60 s.
45	book = crawl.label("book", settings={"timeout": {"handler": timedelta(minutes=3)}})
46	
47	
48	@crawl.handle(home)
49	async def on_home(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[None]) -> None:
50	    await ctx.enqueue_links(
51	        ctx.page.locator(".side_categories ul ul a"), category, limit=3
52	    )
53	
54	
55	@crawl.handle(category)
56	async def on_category(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[None]) -> None:
57	    await ctx.enqueue_links(ctx.page.locator("article.product_pod h3 a"), book)
58	    await ctx.enqueue_links(ctx.page.locator("li.next a"), category)
59	
60	
61	@crawl.handle(book)
62	async def on_book(ctx: AsyncCrawlContext[None]) -> None:
63	    # The first book compiles the Plan entry; the next replay it with no model call, and a page whose layout drifted
64	    # gets one Repair. Past the Model allowance, a step that needs the model raises ModelAllowanceReachedError:
65	    # escaping, it ends this request `skipped` (`model_allowance`).
66	    fields = (await ctx.page.extract("the book on this page", Book)).output
67	    await ctx.push(books, BookRecord(**fields.model_dump(), url=ctx.page.url))
68	
69	
70	async def main() -> None:
71	    # The Model allowance: not a Limit, so the crawl goes on once it is spent.
72	    allowance = Money(amount=Decimal("0.50"), currency="USD")
73	    model = "vercel/openai/gpt-5-mini"
74	    async with AsyncFoxhound.connect(settings={"ai": {"model": model}}) as foxhound:
75	        run = await foxhound.start_crawl(
76	            crawl,
77	            seeds=[seed("https://books.toscrape.com/", home)],
78	            plan=PLAN,
79	            settings={"ai": {"allowance": {"price": allowance}}},
80	        )
81	        async with run:
82	            left = run.outcomes(kinds=["failed", "skipped"], labels=[book])
83	            async for outcome in left:
84	                match outcome:
85	                    case CrawlRequestSkipped(request=request, reason=why, message=text):
86	                        print("unextracted", request.url, why, text)
87	                    case CrawlRequestFailed(request=request, error=error):
88	                        print("unextracted", request.url, error.code, error.fix)
89	                    case _:
90	                        pass
91	            # `incomplete` when a book was skipped for the allowance.
92	            report = await run.finish()
93	    model_use = report.usage.model
94	    print("model use:", model_use.tokens, "tokens,", model_use.price or "unpriced")
95	
96	
97	if __name__ == "__main__":
98	    asyncio.run(main())
